description:
Manage Terraform state. Supports the following operations:
- list: List all resources in state
- show: Show attributes of a specific resource
- mv: Move/rename a resource in state (use with care)
- rm: Remove a resource from state without destroying it (destructive)

address.description: Resource address for show/rm/mv source, e.g. aws_instance.web

destination.description: Destination address for mv operation only

workdir.description: Absolute or relative path to the directory containing .tf files

workspace.description: Terraform workspace to use (default: current workspace)

name: tf_state
